# Agentic Pattern Library

> {{ all.size }} design patterns by Vikas Goyal in two tracks: designing agentic AI systems, and building software with AI coding agents. Each pattern has a problem, forces, solution, when to use and avoid, trade-offs, failure modes, related patterns and a worked example.

Numbers in worked examples are illustrative, not recommendations. Choose real values from your requirements and make them configurable.

## Machine-readable versions

- [All patterns as JSON]({{ D.base | append: 'patterns.json' | absolute_url }}): structured fields for every pattern
- [All patterns as Markdown]({{ D.base | append: 'llms-full.txt' | absolute_url }}): full text of every card in one file
- [Agent skill]({{ D.base | append: 'skill/SKILL.md' | absolute_url }}): drop-in SKILL.md for coding agents
